== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Ornheim]] [[Travelers]] are individuals hailing from the [[Territory]] of [[Ornheim]], a realm associated with [[stone]] and rock. Their primary ability involves summoning various [[constructs]] known as [[Golems|golems]] from their home territory to assist them in combat or other tasks. These summoned entities can take many forms, including [[obsidian wolves]] with amethyst eyes, granite guardians, flint and shale assassins, or even massive [[stone]] temples. Some [[Golems|golems]] are powered by specific heartstones, such as topaz or [[ruby]], and the creation process requires significant patience, preparation, and endurance. In terms of temperament, [[Ornheim]] [[Travelers]] are characterized by their diligence, patience, and ability to remain calm under pressure. Unlike some other [[Travelers]] who may panic, they are known to wait obediently for orders from their Overlord. In battle, they have been seen utilizing [[stone]]-based attacks and summoning massive [[Golems|golems]] to crush enemies. The territory itself is also linked to the [[Ornheim Incarnation]], a large, highly detailed entity made of white [[stone]] with colorful veins that possesses human-like features and immense strength.}}
